title: Simple Hardcore Heart
description: A clean and simple resource pack that adds fake hardcore-style hearts while maintaining Minecraft’s classic vanilla look.
body:
SimpleHardcore Hearts is a minimal and stylish resource pack designed to replace Minecraft’s default hearts with clean hardcore-style hearts, giving the HUD a more intense and polished appearance. The pack enhances the overall interface with a subtle visual upgrade while keeping the familiar vanilla aesthetic intact.

Created with simplicity and clarity in mind, the hearts are designed to look smooth, clean, and easy to recognize during gameplay. The lightweight design ensures that the pack feels natural and blends seamlessly with Minecraft’s original UI without adding unnecessary visual clutter.

Perfect for PvP, survival, hardcore gameplay, and aesthetic-focused setups, SimpleHardcore Hearts adds a clean competitive feel to the game while preserving the classic Minecraft experience. ❤️✨
